probes.question: Hello, I'm Dr Okafor, one of the doctors in the clinic today. What can I help you with?
probes.target: OPEN
probes.credits: Introduced yourself by name and role

probes.question: Are you certain the blood is coming from down below at the front, and not from your bottom or when you pee?
probes.target: You are sure the blood is coming from your vagina.
probes.credits: Where the bleeding is coming from

probes.question: On your worst days, how much do you get through in terms of tampons or pads?
probes.target: Some days you bleed through 6 super tampons and a super pad, a combination, in one day.

probes.question: Do you ever pass lumps or clumps of blood?
probes.target: Sometimes there are clots. When you see clots you get worried.

probes.question: When did you first notice things getting worse than normal for you?
probes.target: They have got worse over the last six months.
probes.credits: When it started and how it has changed

probes.question: Can you remember when your last period began?
probes.target: You cannot really say when your last period was. It is hard to tell, because it never stops.

probes.question: Before all this started, how often would your period come and how many days would it go on for?
probes.target: Your periods used to be regular, every 28 days, lasting 5 or 6 days, heavy for the first 3.
probes.credits: Pattern and length of the periods

probes.question: Do you get any bleeding on the days in between the really heavy ones?
probes.target: The other days of the month you need one regular pad for light bleeding or spotting.
probes.credits: Pattern and length of the periods

probes.question: How old were you when you got your very first period?
probes.target: Your very first period was at age 10.

probes.question: Any stinging when you pee, or needing to go more often?
probes.target: No pain or burning when you pass water. You do not go more often or in a hurry.

probes.question: Have you had any unusual discharge apart from the blood?
probes.target: No discharge from the vagina apart from the blood.

probes.question: Is there anything you've found that eases it, or anything that sets it off?
probes.target: Motrin helps on the bad days when you have cramps.
probes.credits: What makes it better or worse

probes.question: What medicines are you taking right now, including anything you buy from the store?
probes.target: You take no prescription medicine. Only Motrin 600 mg when you need it, for the cramps. No herbs, no supplements.

probes.question: Have you ever been on the pill, the shot, or a coil to stop getting pregnant?
probes.target: You have never used hormone birth control, only condoms.

probes.question: How many times have you been pregnant, and how did those pregnancies end?
probes.target: You have been pregnant 4 times. Three living children, aged 12, 7 and 4, all healthy. No miscarriages. One abortion.

probes.question: How were your babies born?
probes.target: One of the babies came by cesarean because he was breech. The other two were normal births.

probes.question: Have your smear tests always come back normal?
probes.target: You had one abnormal Pap smear back in 2005, and they have all been fine since. Last year's Pap was normal and the extra test for HPV was negative.

probes.question: Have you ever been treated for an infection you can catch through sex?
probes.target: You had chlamydia as a teenager.

probes.question: Are you seeing anyone at the moment, and how many partners have you had over the years?
probes.target: You have sex with your husband, vaginal and oral. You do reach orgasm. He is your only partner now and you have had 3 men in your life.

probes.question: How has the bleeding affected things between you and your husband in bed?
probes.target: If the doctor asks about your sex life, say "My husband doesn't want to have sex with me because I am bleeding all the time. He's grossed out by it; I don't blame him, but it makes me feel bad."

probes.question: Have you had any other health problems or been in hospital for anything, and what health problems do your parents have?
probes.target: Your father is 60, with diabetes and high blood pressure. Your mother is 62, with diabetes. Your sibling is 40, with high blood pressure. The children are healthy.

probes.question: Have you lost or gained weight without trying, or noticed changes in your hair or skin?
probes.target: You are not bothered by heat or cold. No changes in your skin, your hair or your nails. Your weight has not changed on its own.

probes.question: Any temperatures or shivers lately?
probes.target: No fevers and no chills.

probes.question: Have you ever felt you ought to cut down on drinking, or needed a drink first thing in the morning?
probes.target: Every question about drinking too much is a no. Drink has never been a problem for you.

probes.question: Do you smoke at all?
probes.target: You have never smoked. You drink 1 or 2 glasses of wine a month on special occasions, and have done for 15 years. No drugs, ever.

probes.question: How is all this affecting you at work and in your everyday life?
probes.target: It has knocked your confidence, your sex life and your day to day life, especially at work. Say "I'm constantly worrying, am I going to bleed through another pair of underwear or pants today?"

probes.question: Do you get nosebleeds or bleeding gums when you brush your teeth?
probes.target: NOT IN CASE

probes.question: Do you feel dizzy or lightheaded when you get up quickly?
probes.target: NOT IN CASE

probes.question: Have you noticed any milky fluid coming from your nipples?
probes.target: NOT IN CASE

probes.question: Have you been getting bad headaches or trouble with your eyesight?
probes.target: NOT IN CASE

probes.question: Is there anything else you think I should know?
probes.target: OPEN
